latvia.title: Annual Latvia-Estonia Language Award presented
latvia.description: On September 30, 2026, the Latvian and Estonian Foreign Ministers presented the annual Language Award at the ASNI Contemporary Art Gallery. This year, the award went to Katarina Magere, an Estonian language teacher at Rīga Estonian Primary School, for her contribution to the education and development of students by teaching the Estonian language and literature and helping them learn about Estonian culture and traditions.

latvia.title: LISTEN: Santa Šillera in concert on Latvian Radio
latvia.description: Santa Šillera's jazz music programme "Poetry Resounds. Tracings" is available to listen to, and opened the autumn concert season on Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Latvia ends a decade of involvement in operation 'Inherent Resolve'
latvia.description: On Wednesday, September 30, Latvia, together with other coalition partners, officially concluded its participation in the international coalition operation "Inherent Resolve" against the terrorist organization "ISIL/Da'esh", the aim of which was to ensure the military defeat of ISIS in Iraq and Syria.

latvia.title: Ancient, protected grove cut down in Rucava, Latvia
latvia.description: A stand of trees, including a pine at least 377 years old and other trees of a similar age, has been felled in an area managed by the Forest Research Station near Rucava, Liene Brizga-Kalniņa, Head of Communications at the Latvian Fund for Nature (LDF), told the LETA news agency. Experts believe it was one of the oldest pine stands in Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvia signs to buy 'Morana' artillery system in trilateral agreement
latvia.description: On Wednesday, September 30, the Latvian Ministry of Defence, the government of Slovakia and the Czech defence industry company Tatra Defence Systems signed a trilateral agreement for the supply of 155 mm "Morana" artillery systems to the Latvian National Armed Forces (NBS).

latvia.title: Forty dogs removed from cruel conditions in Latvia
latvia.description: The Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) in Dundaga has rescued more than 40 dogs that were being kept in cramped, unsuitable outdoor cages without proper care; some of the dogs were also severely emaciated. All the dogs will be taken to animal shelters.

latvia.title: Drunk-driving Uzulnieks could face up to a year in prison
latvia.description: Reinis Uzulnieks, the former Minister for Welfare, who was caught driving whilst heavily intoxicated and has since been expelled from his party, has been accused under Section 262(1.1) of the Criminal Law for driving with a blood alcohol level of at least 1.5 per mille, Latvian Television reports on September 30.

latvia.title: Majority of young Latvians live in overcrowded homes
latvia.description: New Eurostat data show that a majority of young Latvians live in homes that are classed as "overcrowded".

latvia.title: Two youths rob shooting range in Daugavpils, Latvia
latvia.description: Two young men have been arrested in Daugavpils after stealing firearms from the premises of the Daugavpils shooting range on Sunday, 27 September. The State Police have launched a criminal investigation.

latvia.title: Non-cash payments at an all-time high in Latvia
latvia.description: The proportion of cashless payments in Latvia has reached a record high. In August this year, cashless payments accounted for 81 per cent of transactions, while cash payments made up 19 per cent, according to the latest – autumn 2026 – edition of the Bank of Latvia’s ‘Payment Radar’.

latvia.title: Denniss Cirkins adds some star quality to Latvian football
latvia.description: A new player has pulled on the coveted jersey of the Latvian national football team, making his home debut for the national team on September 28th after a long and rather complicated journey.

latvia.title: 'Arsenāls' exhibition hall in Rīga to be renovated
latvia.description: In order to complete the refurbishment projects for the Great Guild Hall and the ‘Arsenāls’ exhibition hall, the Cabinet of Ministers (MK) decided, at its meeting on 29 September, to support the proposal put forward by the Ministry of Culture (MC) to reallocate flexibility funding from the European Regional Development Fund, amounting to 4,350,933 euros.

latvia.title: Britain pledges nuclear deterrent to defence of Baltic
latvia.description: In response to potential Russian threats, Britain has committed to providing nuclear protection to the members of the Joint Response Force (JRF), including the Baltic states, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Saeima set to okay fuel tax cut in final pre-election session
latvia.description: In its final session before nationwide elections, the Latvian parliament is set to approve cuts to the cost of transport fuel.

latvia.title: CERT: Repeated attacks on municipal surveillance systems in Latvia
latvia.description: Recently, there have been repeated attacks on surveillance systems, cameras and smart building control systems in several regions of Latvia, Varis Teivāns, deputy head of the cyber incident response agency ‘Cert.lv’, said in an interview on the Latvian Television programme ‘Morning Panorama’ on September 30.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 29th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Big growth in aggressor state grain transit via Latvia
latvia.description: Between September 1st and 24th, more than 253 thousand tonnes of grain were transported in transit through Latvia from Russia, and more than 40 thousand tonnes of grain from Belarus, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Extra 10 million allocated to Latvian hospitals
latvia.description: The government on Tuesday approved the allocation of an additional 10 million euros to hospitals from the budget programme ‘Funds for unforeseen circumstances’.

latvia.title: Retail trade experienced uptick in August in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) data published on September 29, retail trade turnover in August 2026 was 3.5 % higher than a year ago (calendar-adjusted data at constant prices).

latvia.title: First two days of advance voting show fairly good turnout in Latvia
latvia.description: During the first two days, around 38,600 people took the opportunity to cast their vote in advance of the 15th Saeima elections, whilst nearly 5,000 more citizens have applied to vote by post, which the Central Election Commission also counts as voter turnout, bringing the total to 2.79 per cent, according to the CVK's information on September 29.

latvia.title: Latvian Freedom Monument is being cleaned
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 29 September, work began on cleaning the Freedom Monument, carried out by SIA “Wenda Wash” on behalf of the Rīga Monuments Agency, the Rīga City Council announced.

latvia.title: Rīga film fest shorts test screening slots confirmed
latvia.description: 'SHORT RIGA Test Screenings', the longest-running section of the Riga International Film Festival (15–25 October) industry programme RIGA IFF FORUM, has announced its lineup for this year's edition.

latvia.title: 'Blue Flag' swimming season considered a success in Rīga
latvia.description: Riga's 'Blue Flag' swimming areas have received a positive assessment from the Environmental Education Foundation and the National Jury of the Blue Flag Programme for the 2026 season, according to a release from Rīga city council.

latvia.title: Latvia a hotspot for fatal workplace accidents
latvia.description: Latvia's rate of fatal accidents at work is considerably higher than the European Union average, according to fresh Eurostat data.

latvia.title: Badger vs. hedgehog brawl results in police action in Aizpute, Latvia
latvia.description: On the night of Saturday, 26 September, the South Kurzeme District Municipal Police received an unusual call from Aizpute, where the residents of a block of flats had had their night’s sleep disturbed by a brawl that had broken out between a hedgehog and a badger, reports the website “liepajniekiem.lv”.

latvia.title: Memorial for first Latvian female MP unveiled in Rīga
latvia.description: On Monday, 28 September, on the birthday of Berta Pīpiņa – the first woman elected to the Saeima and a prominent interwar politician – a commemorative plaque dedicated to her and her husband Ērmanis Pīpiņš-Vizulis was unveiled in Rīga on Ģertrūdes Street, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Latvia and Cyprus play out goalless draw
latvia.description: Neither hosts Latvia nor visitors Cyprus were abe to find the back of the net in their Nations League encounter in Rīga on Monday night.

latvia.title: Around 26,000 cast their vote on Monday in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, September 28th, around 26,000 voters took advantage of the opportunity to vote early and deposit their ballots ahead of the main parliamentary election day on Saturday, October 3rd.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 28th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia v Cyprus international football
latvia.description: Following a 2-0 loss away to Armenia over the weekend, Latvia will hope to get its Nations League campaign up and running properly at home with a match against Cyprus on Monday night.

latvia.title: Convicted money-launderer among investors in Rīga property scheme
latvia.description: A Syrian citizen living in Dubai has become one of the investors in the large-scale real estate project dubbed "Riga Waterfront". However, a few years ago, he was convicted in Denmark in a large-scale money laundering case, LTV's De Facto investigative programme reported on September 27th as part of an investigation carried out in cooperation with the European Broadcast union (EBU) investigative journalism network.

latvia.title: Disgraced drunk-driving former minister not ready to give up politics
latvia.description: If voters elect former Welfare Minister Reinis Uzulnieks to the Saeima at the weekend, he will be ready to carry on working as a member of parliament, the LETA newswire reports.

latvia.title: Latvian football stars face Monday night challenge of Cyprus
latvia.description: The Latvian national football team start the new UEFA Nations League season on September 25th away against Armenia, returning home on the wrong end of a 2:0 scoreline.

latvia.title: Murky water possible in some parts of Rīga this week
latvia.description: From Tuesday 29 September, from 8.00 am on Tuesday 29 September until 8.00 am on Friday 2 October, Rīga water supplier ‘Rīgas ūdens’ will be flushing an 8.5 km section of the water main from Cēsu Street to the water outlet at the Dreiliņi roundabout.

latvia.title: LISTEN AGAIN: Liepāja Symphony Orchestra's 146th season opening concert
latvia.description: Latvian Radio is delighted to bring you live coverage of the Liepāja Symphony Orchestra's season opening concert from September 19th, direct from the 'Lielais Dzintars' concert hall in Liepāja.

latvia.title: Not enough passion in Latvian politics says ex-President Zatlers
latvia.description: Pre-election campaigning for the upcoming Saeima elections lacks the passion that could stimulate voters/' interest in going to vote, former President Valdis Zatlers said on the Latvian Television programme "Morning Panorama" on September 28th.

latvia.title: Security service says it is keeping a close eye on Latvian election campaign
latvia.description: During the current pre-election period, the State Security Service (VDD) is keeping a close eye on "what is happening in society and the information space" in order to prevent attempts to illegally influence the course and results of the 15th Saeima elections, it said on September 28th.

latvia.title: Nurse gets prison sentence over medication mishap causing death
latvia.description: On Monday, 28 September, Riga City Court sentenced a nurse at the Children’s Clinical University Hospital (BKUS) to two and a half years’ imprisonment after she accidentally mixed up the medication to be administered to a patient last November, resulting in the patient’s death.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank will discuss 'new geopolitical reality' in November
latvia.description: Latvijas Banka, the Latvian central bank (LB), has released a few details of its next annual conference, which "will focus on the economic challenges the euro area is facing in the new geopolitical reality."

latvia.title: Parties pore over polls in final days of Saeima election campaign
latvia.description: With just a few days to go before Latvia's parliamentary elections on October 3rd, parties continue to jostle for position, according to the latest data from the SKDS pollster produced for Latvian Television.

latvia.title: One final week of summer in store for Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that Latvia will experience summery weather this week.

latvia.title: Latvian parliamentary candidate's education info raises questions
latvia.description: Uncertainty has arisen regarding the educational background stated by Artūrs Butāns, a Member of the Saeima for the National Alliance (NA), in the last three Saeima elections, according to information compiled by the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Early voting starts Monday for Latvian parliamentary elections
latvia.description: During the week of the 15th Saeima elections, from Monday 28 September to Friday 2 October, voters can cast their votes in advance. This can be done at any of the 933 polling stations across Latvia, according to the Central Election Commission (CVK).

latvia.title: Sunny and warm Monday in Latvia
latvia.description: Monday morning in Latvia is chilly, and foggy in many places, but the day is set to be sunny and warm, according to forecasts by Toms Bricis, LSM's weatherman.

latvia.title: Store-bought shelters a consideration for Latvia
latvia.description: To date, the main focus in establishing a network of bomb shelters in Latvia has been on identifying and adapting the basements of existing state and local authority buildings. One of the next steps involves industrially manufactured shelters. The Ministry of Economics is currently preparing standard documentation for the procurement of such shelters, Latvian Radio reported on September 28.

lithuania.description: Többek mellett Windisch Lászlónak is üzent a miniszterelnök, miután Magyarországon 1990 óta először elrendelték egy volt miniszter letartóztatását.

lithuania.title: A dublini orosz nagykövetség nukleáris csapásokkal fenyegetőzik
lithuania.description: A diplomáciai külképviselet arra az esetre helyezte kilátásba az atomháborút, ha a NATO blokád alá venné Kalinyingrádot.

lithuania.title: Rutte szerint Putyin tudja, hogy soha nem győzheti le a NATO-t, ezért nem veszi túl komolyan az oroszok nukleáris fenyegetését
lithuania.description: Viszont a NATO-főtitkár azt mondta, Oroszországnak fel kell hagynia a nukleáris fenyegetéssel.

lithuania.title: Nukleáris fegyvereket vetnének be az oroszok, ha a NATO megpróbálná elszigetelni a kalinyingrádi exklávét
lithuania.description: Moszkva szerint magas a közvetlen konfliktus kitörésének kockázata.

lithuania.title: Atomtámadással fenyegetőzik Moszkva, titkos tárgyalások folynak Amerikában - Híreink az ukrajnai háborúról szerdán
lithuania.description: Lezuhant egy orosz Tu-95-ös hadászati bombázó az orosz Távol-Keleten, az incidens okait egyelőre viszgálják. Washingtoban nem bejelentett módon tárgyalnak az amerikaiak az oroszokkal, Kirill Dmitrijev főtárgyaló a városban van. Hajnalban súlyos támadás érte Kijevet: az ukrán főváros lángokban áll. A fronton az oroszok Dobropillját és Kosztyantynivkát szorongatják, Limanról az ukrán ellentámadásnak köszönhetően enyhült a nyomás. A nap folyamán Oroszország arról kezdett el kommunikálni, hogy Európa blokádolni akarja Kalinyingrádot, így atomtámadással is megfenyegették a NATO európai országait. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború szerdai eseményeivel.

lithuania.title: Visszaszólt a NATO erős embere, miután Moszkva atommal fenyegetett: Putyin soha nem győzheti le a NATO-t!
lithuania.description: A NATO védelmi szövetség, Oroszországnak pedig fel kell hagynia a nukleáris fenyegetésekkel és véget kell vetnie az Ukrajna elleni háborúnak - jelentette ki Mark Rutte NATO-főtitkár szerdán Brüsszelben.

lithuania.title: Durva üzenetet kapott a NATO: atomtámadással fenyeget Moszkva – Nem hagyták szó nélkül
lithuania.description: Oroszország a Kalinyingrád elleni állítólagos fenyegetésekre válaszul nem hivatalos jegyzéket juttatott el a NATO-nak, amelyben nukleáris fegyverek bevetésével fenyegetőzött. A katonai szövetség határozottan elítélte a lépést, és felelőtlennek nevezte az orosz retorikát - írja az Ukrajinszka Pravda .

lithuania.title: Bedurvultak az oroszok: ha Európa ezt tényleg megteszi, Moszkva indítja az atomfegyvereket
lithuania.description: Nukleáris fegyverekkel fog csapást mérni Oroszország, ha a NATO megpróbálja blokád alá vonni Kalinyingrádot – közölte Oroszország dublini nagykövetsége a Kyiv Independent cikke szerint.

lithuania.title: „Ak zlyhá odstrašenie, budeme musieť bojovať.“ Rusko sa približuje k červeným čiaram NATO
lithuania.description: Poľský minister zahraničných vecí Radosław Sikorski varoval, že Rusko môže pripravovať rozsiahlejšiu operáciu v Európe. Podľa neho by Moskva mohla hľadať zámienku na mobilizáciu prostredníctvom incidentu, ktorý by prezentovala ako útok na Rusko.

lithuania.title: Rutte upokojuje Európu: Rusko podľa NATO nepredstavuje bezprostrednú hrozbu. Varuje však pred hybridnými útokmi
lithuania.description: Krajiny Severoatlantickej aliancie nečelia zo strany Ruska bezprostrednej hrozbe, vyhlásil dnes generálny tajomník NATO Mark Rutte. Hodnotenie rizika, ktoré predstavuje Rusko, je rovnaké ako pred rokom, dodal podľa agentúry Reuters.

lithuania.title: Na pomoc Pobaltí bychom v případě napadení museli vyslat dvě brigády, řekl Babiš
lithuania.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) se v úterý po uložení korunovačních klenotů setkal s prezidentem Petrem Pavlem. Předseda vlády serveru Deník.cz řekl, že s hlavou státu diskutoval o programu příští Bezpečnostní rady státu, včetně možné reakce na případný ruský útok na některý z pobaltských států. „Pokud by nedej bože došlo k tomu, že by Rusko napadlo nějaký pobaltský stát, tak podle článku pět (NATO) musíme vyslat dvě naše mechanizované brigády,“ sdělil premiér.

lithuania.title: Senát schválil nižší počet vojáků bránící východní křídlo NATO
lithuania.description: Na obranu východního křídla NATO bude moci být v příštích dvou letech vysláno nejvýše 1600 českých vojáků, o 400 méně než dosud, schválil Senát. Zároveň dal šanci novému pokusu o ústavní zakotvení práva na život off-line. Dva obdobné návrhy na doplnění Listiny základních práv a svobod přitom v minulosti odmítl. Dále má na programu senátorské návrhy o nepromlčitelnosti trestného činu vraždy a o daňové úlevě pro dobrovolné hasiče.

lithuania.title: Estonsko obvinilo Rusko ze žhářského útoku na zbrojní firmu
lithuania.description: Estonsko uvedlo, že srpnový požár v tallinském zbrojním podniku Milrem Robotics byl způsoben žhářským útokem provedeným na rozkaz ruských tajných služeb. Informovala o tom stanice ERR. Firma dodává Ruskem napadené Ukrajině pozemní drony. Moskva podíl na požáru popřela. Generální tajemník NATO Mark Rutte prohlásil, že ruské hybridní útoky proti aliančním zemím neoslabí podporu Ukrajině.

lithuania.title: SUA dezmint că pregătesc retragerea a zeci de mii de militari din Europa: „Aceste informații sunt false”
lithuania.description: Statele Unite nu intenționează să retragă între 25.000 și 40.000 de militari din Europa, a declarat ambasadorul american la NATO, Matthew Whitaker, care a dezmințit informațiile apărute în presă. Washingtonul își reevaluează însă prezența militară pe continent, proces care ar urma să fie finalizat până la sfârșitul anului, potrivit AFP și Agerpres.

lithuania.title: Mark Rutte: Nu există nicio ameninţare iminentă dinspre Rusia pentru teritoriul NATO. „Ne putem permite un pic de calm”
lithuania.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a afirmat miercuri că nu există o ameninţare iminentă pentru teritoriul Alianţei Nord-Atlantice şi că evaluarea ameninţării ruse este neschimbată faţă de acum trei săptămâni, trei luni sau un an, informează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Un zbor Dubai-Tel Aviv a aterizat în Arabia Saudită după o alertă de deturnare. Oficial israelian: „Un pilot l-a înjunghiat pe altul”
lithuania.description: Un zbor Flydubai de la Dubai la Tel Aviv, cu 174 de pasageri la bord, dintre care 27 de copii, a aterizat miercuri în Arabia Saudită după ce o altercație fizică între piloți a declanșat un semnal de urgență care a stârnit inițial temeri privind o deturnare și a determinat Israelul să mobilizeze avioane de vânătoare, relatează ynetnews.com.

lithuania.title: Moscova a avertizat oficial NATO că va folosi armele nucleare dacă Alianța va încerca să izoleze o exclavă rusă
lithuania.description: Kremlinul a confirmat miercuri că Rusia a transmis avertismente de natură nucleară către NATO prin care atenţionează Alianţa cu privire la riscurile unei eventuale încercări de izolare a exclavei ruse Kaliningrad, pentru a le reaminti astfel „capetelor înfierbântate" din Europa dispoziţiile politicii Moscovei în cazul unor acţiuni de acest fel, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu: Orice sprijin pentru Ucraina trebuie condiționat. Sancțiunile asupra Rusiei sunt consecința etichetării ca stat agresor
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, a declarat miercuri, în direct la Digi24, că „orice sprijin trebuie să fie condiționat” în cazul Ucrainei și că partidul consideră Rusia „un stat agresor”. Peiu a precizat că AUR „nu își propune să schimbe aranjamentele internaționale ale României”.

lithuania.title: Cehia susține că ar fi gata să-și onoreze angajamentele față de NATO dacă Rusia atacă o țară baltică: „Desigur că ne pregătim”
lithuania.description: Republica Cehă ar fi pregătită să-și onoreze angajamentele față de NATO în cazul unui atac al Rusiei asupra unei țări baltice, a declarat marți prim-ministrul Andrej Babis pentru un site de știri ceh, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Rusia amenință Europa cu atacuri nucleare. În ce situație va folosi țara lui Putin focoasele strategice
lithuania.description: Rusia va recurge la toate mijloacele de care dispune, inclusiv cele nucleare, în cazul în care țările NATO vor încerca să blocheze regiunea Kaliningrad sau să o atace, a declarat Ambasada Federației Ruse în Marea Britanie.

lithuania.title: Tensiuni explozive la granița NATO. Alianța militară respinge avertismentul Rusiei privind Kaliningrad și promite autoapărare totală
lithuania.description: NATO a respins, marţi, cu fermitate, un avertisment venit din partea Moscovei privind o escaladare militară serioasă în jurul exclavei ruse Kaliningrad, informează DPA.

lithuania.title: Rutte: Rusia nu poate sparge unitatea NATO. Cum răspunde Alianța la atacurile cu drone și sabotajele hibride
lithuania.description: Rutte a afirmat că Rusia nu a reușit să zdruncine unitatea NATO, în ciuda actelor de sabotaj și a atacurilor cu drone. Alianța își consolidează apărarea și sprijinul acordat Ucrainei.

lithuania.title: CCR a decis că femeile asigurate pe cont propriu nu pot fi excluse de la concediul și indemnizația de risc maternal
lithuania.description: Curtea Constituțională a decis marți, cu unanimitate de voturi, că femeile asigurate pe cont propriu, printr-un contract încheiat cu casa de sănătate, nu pot fi excluse de la concediul și indemnizația de risc maternal doar pentru că nu au statutul de salariate. Judecătorii au stabilit că această diferență de tratament este discriminatorie și încalcă dreptul la ocrotirea sănătății și la un nivel de trai decent.

lithuania.title: Viceguvernator BNR: „Prelungirea crizei politice devine tot mai problematică. Revenirea la normalitate este esențială”
lithuania.description: România înregistrează „semne bune” în reducerea dezechilibrelor bugetare, progrese observate și de agențiile de rating, însă prelungirea crizei politice pune tot mai multe probleme, avertizează viceguvernatorul BNR Cosmin Marinescu. Acesta spune că revenirea la normalitate în planul guvernării este esențială pentru încrederea investitorilor și a mediului de afaceri.

lithuania.title: O dronă rusă a avariat un punct de frontieră ucrainean de la graniţa cu Polonia. Vămi închise temporar
lithuania.description: O dronă rusă cu motor cu reacţie a lovit luni satul ucrainean Starovoitove, situat lângă graniţa cu Polonia, avariind un punct de control la frontieră, a anunţat guvernatorul interimar al regiunii Volînia.

lithuania.title: Anunțul ambasadorului american la NATO despre reducerile masive de trupe din Europa. „Am repetat constant”
lithuania.description: SUA nu se pregătesc să retragă între 25.000 și 40.000 de trupe de pe continentul european, a afirmat ambasadorul american la NATO, Matthew Whitaker, dezmințind informații în acest sens apărute anterior în presă, scrie AFP. „Aceste informații sunt false”, a declarat Whitaker în cadrul unei conferințe pe tema apărării organizate miercuri la Bruxelles de canalul …

lithuania.description: Ja NATO kolektīvi lems un būs tāda nepieciešamība, Latvijā varēs izvietot kodolieročus, šodien žurnālistiem sacīja Latvijas prezidents Edgars Rinkēvičs.
